author: XamOps Team
description: Seed manifest for 21 production-ready Ansible playbooks for configuration management. The bulk-import task (4.6) reads each entry, loads the referenced .yml playbook from the classpath at codeBaseDir/codeFile, and persists a DevOpsScript plus its ScriptParameter rows. Customizable seed values use the UPPERCASE {{PARAMETER_NAME}} placeholder syntax (e.g. {{TARGET_HOSTS}}, {{DOMAIN_NAME}}, {{DB_PASSWORD}}); genuine Ansible runtime variables keep the normal lowercase, spaced Jinja2 form (e.g. {{ domain_name }}) so the two never collide.

scripts.name: Install Nginx with SSL
scripts.description: Installs Nginx and Certbot, deploys an HTTPS reverse-proxy server block for a domain, and obtains a Let's Encrypt certificate with automatic HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect.
scripts.prerequisites: Debian/Ubuntu host reachable on ports 80/443, a DNS A record pointing the domain at the host, and Ansible control node access.

parameters.name: TARGET_HOSTS
parameters.label: Target Hosts
parameters.description: Inventory group or host pattern to run the play against.

parameters.name: DOMAIN_NAME
parameters.label: Domain Name
parameters.description: Fully qualified domain name for the HTTPS site.

parameters.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
parameters.label: Admin Email
parameters.description: Email used for Let's Encrypt registration and expiry notices.

parameters.name: APP_PORT
parameters.label: Upstream App Port
parameters.description: Local application port Nginx proxies traffic to.

scripts.name: Set Up PostgreSQL with Replication
scripts.description: Installs PostgreSQL on a primary node and configures streaming replication: creates a replication role, enables WAL streaming, and authorizes a replica CIDR in pg_hba.conf.
scripts.prerequisites: Debian/Ubuntu primary host with root access; network reachability from the replica's CIDR. The community.postgresql collection installed on the control node.

parameters.name: TARGET_HOSTS
parameters.label: Target Hosts
parameters.description: Inventory group or host pattern for the primary node.

parameters.name: PG_VERSION
parameters.label: PostgreSQL Version
parameters.description: PostgreSQL major version to install (e.g. 16).

parameters.name: REPL_USER
parameters.label: Replication User
parameters.description: Name of the replication role to create.

parameters.name: REPL_PASSWORD
parameters.label: Replication Password
parameters.description: Password for the replication role.

parameters.name: REPLICA_CIDR
parameters.label: Replica CIDR
parameters.description: CIDR block allowed to connect for replication, e.g. 10.0.0.0/24.

parameters.name: MAX_WAL_SENDERS
parameters.label: Max WAL Senders
parameters.description: Maximum number of concurrent WAL sender processes.

scripts.name: Deploy Node.js App with PM2
scripts.description: Installs Node.js via NodeSource, clones an application from Git, installs production dependencies, and runs it under the PM2 process manager with startup on boot.
scripts.prerequisites: Debian/Ubuntu host with root access and outbound internet; a reachable Git repository containing a Node.js application.

parameters.name: TARGET_HOSTS
parameters.label: Target Hosts
parameters.description: Inventory group or host pattern to deploy to.

parameters.name: APP_NAME
parameters.label: Application Name
parameters.description: PM2 process name for the application.

parameters.label: Node.js Version
parameters.description: Node.js major version to install (e.g. 20).

parameters.name: REPO_URL
parameters.label: Repository URL
parameters.description: Git repository URL to deploy from.

parameters.name: APP_DIR

parameters.description: Filesystem directory to clone and run the app from.

parameters.name: ENTRY_POINT
parameters.label: Entry Point
parameters.description: Application entry script PM2 launches, e.g. dist/server.js.

scripts.name: Configure Firewall (UFW)
scripts.description: Establishes a deny-by-default UFW firewall baseline, rate-limits SSH, and opens a customizable comma-separated list of additional TCP service ports.
scripts.prerequisites: Debian/Ubuntu host with root access. Confirm the SSH port before enabling to avoid lockout. community.general collection on the control node.

parameters.name: TARGET_HOSTS
parameters.label: Target Hosts
parameters.description: Inventory group or host pattern to run the play against.

parameters.name: SSH_PORT
parameters.label: SSH Port
parameters.description: TCP port allowed and rate-limited for SSH access.

parameters.name: ALLOWED_TCP
parameters.label: Allowed TCP Ports
parameters.description: Comma-separated extra TCP ports to allow, e.g. 80,443.

scripts.name: Harden SSH Access
scripts.description: Hardens the OpenSSH daemon: disables root login and password authentication, enforces key-based auth, sets a custom port, limits auth tries, and restricts allowed users with sshd config validation.
scripts.prerequisites: Root access and a working SSH key for the allowed users. Keep an active session open while applying to avoid lockout.

parameters.name: TARGET_HOSTS
parameters.label: Target Hosts
parameters.description: Inventory group or host pattern to run the play against.

parameters.name: SSH_PORT
parameters.label: SSH Port
parameters.description: Port the SSH daemon should listen on.

parameters.name: ALLOWED_USERS
parameters.label: Allowed Users
parameters.description: Space-separated list of users permitted to log in via SSH.

parameters.name: MAX_AUTH_TRIES
parameters.label: Max Auth Tries
parameters.description: Maximum authentication attempts permitted per connection.

scripts.name: Install and Configure fail2ban
scripts.description: Installs fail2ban and deploys an SSH jail that bans hosts exceeding a configurable number of failed authentication attempts within a time window.
scripts.prerequisites: Debian/Ubuntu host with root access and systemd (used as the fail2ban backend).

parameters.name: TARGET_HOSTS
parameters.label: Target Hosts

parameters.name: SSH_PORT
parameters.label: SSH Port
parameters.description: SSH port the jail protects.

parameters.name: BAN_TIME
parameters.label: Ban Time (s)
parameters.description: Ban duration in seconds for offending hosts.

parameters.name: FIND_TIME
parameters.label: Find Time (s)
parameters.description: Window in seconds over which failures are counted.

parameters.name: MAX_RETRY
parameters.label: Max Retry
parameters.description: Failed attempts allowed before a ban is applied.
